description: Claude-specific compact recovery, event-driven wakeup for an explicitly waiting autonomous goal, and session-end suspension. The shared hooks file supplies synchronous Stop verification and continuation.

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultragoal/scripts/goal_pre_compact.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_pre_compact.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_pre_compact.py"

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultragoal/scripts/goal_drive.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P" interrupt; else exec python "$P" interrupt; fi
hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_drive.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_drive.py" interrupt

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultragoal/scripts/goal_drive.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P" wake-hook; else exec python "$P" wake-hook; fi
hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_drive.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_drive.py" wake-hook
